import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP, create_proxy
from fastmcp.client import FastMCPTransport, Client


async def main():
    # Assume backend_server is an existing FastMCP server instance
    backend_server = FastMCP("backend-server", instructions="Backend server")
    
    @backend_server.tool()
    def example_tool(name: str) -> str:
        """Example tool on backend server."""
        return f"Hello, {name}!"
    
    @backend_server.resource()
    def example_resource() -> str:
        """Example resource on backend server."""
        return "Resource content"
    
    # Create a transparent proxy that forwards all requests to the backend
    proxy_server = create_proxy(backend_server, name="proxy-server")
    
    # Run the proxy server
    await proxy_server.run_stdio_async()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
